statement: Shubha Kartari Yoga (the Ascendant 'hemmed' on both sides -- 2nd and 12th houses -- exclusively by natural benefics) is traditionally read as carrying ease, support, and a generally smooth, well-resourced life, protectively enclosed by favorable influence on either side of the self.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
